newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Interacciones begins Gissa at hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Interacciones begins Gissa at hold.

text.p: --Interacciones brokerage initiated coverage of industrial holding company Grupo Industrial Saltillo (Gissa) with a hold recommendation.

--Analyst Robert Hulme said that, while the company had performed well at an operating level recently, this had already been discounted by the market and thus the stock's scope for appreciation had been limited.
--Gissa was trading at 13.5 times forecast 1997 earnings per share, compared with an average of 8.8 times for the sector in which it trades.
